verdict.rationale: Docs confirm balance accounts/pools per card, transaction-level authorization webhooks, and export of consolidated expense data to accounting systems, giving partial visibility into money movement. However there is no evidence of a real-time balance dashboard, a unified transaction ledger tying every authorization to its clearing/settlement event, or penny-accurate settlement reconciliation reporting. Missing for 10: real-time balance/ledger UI evidence, explicit authorization-to-clearing linkage in reporting, settlement reconciliation accuracy claims, and independent corroboration of reporting precision.
